notes_for_editor: Index-only evidence from tnlandforms (GA359). Not listed on the NHLR Georgia list or the FFLOS and FFLA Georgia pages. The index tag 'datasheet ED1735' is not explained on the page and is not used. A search snippet from anyplaceamerica.com (page returned 403, not read) calls the peak Chestnut Mountain in Hall County; unverified and not cited. The story is about 73 words, well under the roughly 120-word floor for thin evidence; consider holding it. The index states no unit for elevation. Feet are an inference: the record's metres match 1,210 ft, and the index's largest values (4735 for GA006) cannot be metres in Georgia. The Tom Dunigan attribution does not appear on the page and was removed. The name 'price mtn' is the index author's label, not an official name.
